Superpočítačů HPE Cray nové generace přinášejí špičkovou výpočetní hustotu pro AI. Od firewallu k AI agentům: Nová éra kybernetické války. Vědci vyvinuli magnetický tranzistor pro energeticky účinnější elektroniku. Nový Acronis Cyber Protect posiluje odolnost pro on-premise IT/OT prostředí.

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Polemika se svobodnou vůlí. Na Slovensku se chystá spuštění superpočítače PERUN. Co skrývá Uran a Neptun? Nemusí jít o nic exotického.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Vysvětlili zdánlivě nemožnou fúzi černých děr

articles.description: Gravitační vlny naznačují existenci černých děr druhé generace. Poprvé pozorovali vznik jediného kvarku top s bosony W a Z. Umělá inteligence jako autor, kvantová fyzika – a vlkodlaci. Inspekce elektrických sítí se posouvá do éry autonomních dronů.

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Společnost Collabora vydala (YouTube) na LibreOffice založený desktopový kancelářský balík Collabora Office. Pro Windows, macOS a Linux. Se stejným uživatelským rozhraním jako Collabora Online. Svůj desktopový kancelářský balík s rozhraním LibreOffice pojmenovala Collabora Office Classic.
articles.title: Collabora Office pro desktop

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Glen MacArthur vydal AV Linux (AVL) a MX Moksha (MXM) 25. S linuxovým jádrem Liquorix. AV Linux (Wikipedie) je linuxová distribuce optimalizována pro tvůrce audio a video obsahu. Nejnovější AV Linux vychází z MX Linuxu 25 a Debianu 13 Trixie. AV Linux přichází s desktopovým prostředím Enlightenment 0.27.1 a MX Moksha s prostředím Moksha 0.4.1 (fork Enlightenmentu).
articles.title: AV Linux (AVL) a MX Moksha (MXM) 25

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Ubuntu pro testování nových verzí vydává měsíční snapshoty. Dnes vyšel 1. snapshot Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (Resolute Raccoon).
articles.title: 1. snapshot Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (Resolute Raccoon)

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Zástupci členských států EU se včera shodli na návrhu, který má bojovat proti šíření materiálů na internetu zobrazujících sexuální zneužívání dětí. Nařízení známé pod zkratkou CSAM a přezdívané chat control mělo množství kritiků a dlouho nebyla pro jeho schválení dostatečná podpora. Pro schválení byla potřeba kvalifikovaná většina a dánské předsednictví v Radě EU se snažilo dosáhnout kompromisu. Návrh nakonec po dlouhých týdnech jednání podpořilo Německo, které bylo dlouho proti. Se schválenou pozicí nyní půjde Rada EU do vyjednávání s Evropským parlamentem.
articles.title: Riziko prolamování šifrované komunikace: Státy EU se shodly na návrhu proti dětské pornografii

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Britské herní studio Facepunch stojící za počítačovými hrami Garry's Mod a Rust uvolnilo svůj herní engine s&box (Wikipedie) jako open source. Zdrojové kódy jsou k dispozici na GitHubu pod licencí MIT. Herní engine s&box je postavený nad proprietárním herním enginem Source 2 od společnosti Valve.
articles.title: Herní engine s&box je open source

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Vývoj programovacího jazyka Zig byl přesunut z GitHubu na Codeberg. Sponzoring na Every.
articles.title: Vývoj Zigu přesunut z GitHubu na Codeberg

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description:
Poslanci Evropského parlamentu dnes vyzvali k výraznému zvýšení ochrany nezletilých na internetu, včetně zákazu vstupu na sociální sítě pro osoby mladší 16 let. Legislativně nezávazná zpráva, kterou dnes odsouhlasil Evropský parlament poměrem 493 hlasů pro ku 92 proti, kromě zavedení věkové hranice 16 let pro využívání sociálních sítí, platforem pro sdílení videí či společníků s umělou inteligencí (AI) vyzývá také k zákazu nejnebezpečnějších návykových praktik na internetu u mladistvých. How to obtain the Forsaken Vow Blade in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 1

Screenshot by Destructoid


Interact with the gate to enter, and defeat the NPC enemies at the location. To do so, you'll have to use the Forsaken Vow Blade (provided to you in the rift). Once done, you can now use the Blade on the open map.


How to hit opponents with Vengeance Dash in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season


Ensure that you have equipped the Forsaken Vow Blade. Next, aim at an enemy, and press the right mouse button. The Vengeance Dash ability is a set of powerful charged slashes that you can use to destroy any opponent.


Screenshot by Destructoid


The ability has three max rounds and takes a fair bit of time to reload (hence, don't spam). There's a brief period for it to lock onto an enemy before landing the hit. Try to hit from close range so that your target can't dodge the incoming charge.


Once you hit opponents with the Vengeance Dash ability six times, it will complete the quest and reward you with 10,000 XP.

Some Fortnite players have started getting the 'Waiting in Queue' message pop-up as they're trying to get into the servers ahead of the Zero Hour season finale.


While Zero Hour is still a few minutes away from launch, many players have been logging in early. This was also recommended by the developers to avoid server load. If you're getting this message, you're not alone.


What does the 'Waiting in Queue' message mean in Fortnite


In simple words, the 'Waiting in Queue' message means that too many players are trying to log into the servers at the same time. If that happens, it can cause network disturbances and outages for all. To prevent that, Epic Games has placed the queue so that only a certain number of players can log in at a given time.


Image via Epic Games Store


This allows players to log in smoothly despite having to wait for a specific amount of time. This will vary based on your luck and how many players are trying to join the servers ahead of you. If the queue is in place, there's no way to bypass the restriction. You'll have to wait patiently till the time is up, which will allow you to access all the modes.


While the latest incident is happening ahead of the Zero Hour finale event, there have been such queues in the past. If you logged in early, chances are that you haven't had to wait. If you're unfortunate enough, your only option is to wait patiently. As an alternative, try switching your servers, as all the queues are region-based. A region with fewer active players might not have the queue in the first place. 


There's plenty in store for Fortnite players on Nov. 29, as we have the Zero Hour finale event coming up at 1pm CT, followed by Chapter 7 a few hours later. Expect to have a few login issues as players from all over the globe will be aiming to enjoy all the new content.

Soulframe Preludes has different factions for you to join on your adventures, and they can be an excellent source for grinding various rewards.


Introduced in Preludes 9, factions represent different attributes. Your faction is decided at the time of creating your character, and there are three different options. This guide will provide you with all the details regarding how factions work.


Table of contents
All factions in Soulframe
How to change factions in Soulframe


All factions in Soulframe


As of Preludes 12, there are three factions available for you to pick from.



Alca's Children: You can obtain this faction by pledging to Spirit.


Kith of Kings: You can get this faction by pledging to Courage


Silent Rose: You can get this faction by pledging to Grace.



Every faction has a hidden enclave that you'll locate as part of your quests. You can then speak with the enclave's leader to get repeatable quests called Tales. Complete them to earn rewards and faction XP. While the quests are entirely random, they provide a steady stream of valuable items that allow you to craft. Your faction standing will also increase by gaining more Faction XP.


Screenshot by Destructoid


A higher faction standing will also increase the number of options you can find in the Favors section. You can purchase plenty of different items from the Faction Leader. Having a higher standing will increase the variety of items available for purchase.


How to change factions in Soulframe


You can have at most one faction active at any given time, but you can switch between the available options.



To switch your faction, you'll need an applicable totem.


You can craft the totem using fragments, and they're pretty easy to collect.


Once you have the token, equip it from the inventory. Then speak with a representative, and you'll be able to switch.

articles.description:
Is downloading a YouTube video a violation of the DMCA's anti-circumvention provision? That is the key question in the legal battle between stream-ripper Yout and the RIAA. Yout argues that because YouTube videos are freely accessible to anyone with a web browser, there are no restrictions. The RIAA counters that Yout is confusing the right to watch a stream with the right to download a copy of the music file.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Yout and RIAA Clash in Court Over YouTube’s Alleged Copyright Barriers

After receiving a three-year prison sentence earlier this year, an appeal only made the situation worse. After noticing a history of recidivism and a lack of remorse, the court extended the former operator's original three-year sentence by 18 months.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Site Operator’s Appeal Goes Bad, Court Extends Prison Term By 50%

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: MPA Shut Down OnionPlay’s Discord & Tries to Unmask Pirate Site Operator

The case is seen as a landmark victory in Germany, as it indicates that operators of seemingly "neutral" cyberlocker platforms can be held liable. At the same time, €50 million in revenue and evaporated threats against users leave unanswered questions. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Share-Online Operator Gets Two Years Probation in Landmark ‘Cyberlocker’ Verdict

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

articles.description: Velká hromada vteřinových (i kratších) gagů, většinou nápaditě předabovaných, takže fungovaly i v češtině. U některých jsem se dokonce zasmál. Ale hlavně aby se pořád bum, bum něco dělo a divák nemohl začít přemýšlet. Jinak žádné překvapení. Nudná a předvídatelná zápletka, spousta protixenofobních a protirasistických poučení (rysové mají bílé privilegium!) a vizuálně nic extra - především kulisy v pozadí mi přišly podivně bez hloubky. articles.description: Po prvním filmu jsem choval naději, že příběh je pouze nakousnut a o rok později se uzavře a epicky vyvrcholí. Bohužel, druhý film vypadá podstatně laciněji, je mnohen hůř zrežírovaný a chybí mu všechno to, co činilo první film aspoň snesitelným. A děj nedává smysl nejen v návaznosti na starého "Čaroděje ze země Oz", ale ani v návaznosti na první "Čarodějku", což je vskutku bizarní. (Ilča 30 %)

Ramsayová pravděpodobně natočila přesně to, co chtěla, ale pro mě to bylo k nevydržení, podobně jako většina filmů Larse von Triera. (Ilča 30 %)

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Je to nechutné, zábavné a občas to nakousavá nějaká hlubší témata. Připomnělo mi to starší filmy Davida Cronenberga, ve kterých byl mladý, neklidný a vtipný (pokud jste měli hodně vyšinutý smysl pro humor). Hezky to šlape, není tam nic zbytečného navíc a je to dobrý příklad toho, že můžete natočit dobře fungující film za relativně málo peněz. (Ilča 80 %)

executing arbitrary code.

certain return values. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause
libxml2 to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2025-32414)

operations. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause
libxml2 to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2025-32415)

corresponding fix for Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS and
Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.

 It was discovered that libxslt, used by libxml2, incorrectly handled
 certain attributes. An attacker could use this issue to cause a crash,
 resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. This
 update adds a fix to libxml2 to mitigate the libxslt vulnerability.
articles.title: USN-7852-2: libxml2 vulnerability

articles.description:
Several security issues were discovered in the WebKitGTK Web and JavaScript
engines. If a user were tricked into viewing a malicious website, a remote
attacker could exploit a variety of issues related to web browser security,
including cross-site scripting attacks, denial of service attacks, and
arbitrary code execution.
articles.title: USN-7895-1: WebKitGTK vulnerabilities

articles.description:
USN-7886-1 fixed vulnerabilities in Python. This update provides the
corresponding updates for python3.13 in Ubuntu 25.04 and Ubuntu 25.10.

Original advisory details:

 It was discovered that Python inefficiently handled expanding system
 environment variables. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause
 Python to consume excessive resources, leading to a denial of service.
 (CVE-2025-6075)

 Caleb Brown discovered that Python incorrectly handled the ZIP64 End of
 Central Directory (EOCD) Locator record offset value. An attacker could
 possibly use this issue to obfuscate malicious content. (CVE-2025-8291)
articles.title: USN-7886-2: Python vulnerabilities

Sequence Number. An attacker could possibly use this issue to gain

articles.description:
Benny Isaacs, Nir Brakha, and Sagi Tzadik discovered that Valkey incorrectly
handled memory when running Lua scripts. An authenticated attacker could
use this vulnerability to trigger a use-after-free condition, and
potentially achieve remote code execution on the Valkey server.
(CVE-2025-49844)

It was discovered that Valkey incorrectly handled memory when running Lua
scripts. An authenticated attacker could use this vulnerability to trigger
a integer overflow condition, and potentially achieve remote code execution
on the Valkey server. (CVE-2025-46817)

It was discovered that Valkey incorrectly handled Lua objects. An
authenticated attacker could possibly use this issue to escalate their
privileges. (CVE-2025-46818)

It was discovered that Valkey incorrectly handled memory when running Lua
scripts. An authenticated attacker could use this vulnerability to read
out-of-bounds memory, causing a denial of service or possibly obtaining
sensitive information. (CVE-2025-46819)

It was discovered that Valkey incorrectly handled memory in some
calculations. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial
of service. (CVE-2025-49112)
articles.title: USN-7893-1: Valkey vulnerabilities

crash, resulting in a denial of service.
